comparator.name: International Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: Current official programme verifies a 60+60+60 Africa/Arabic pathway. The revised first year uses Introduction to International Studies10 and Humanities in a Digital World5; former Academic Literacy and Foundations of Political Economy are not added. Communicating Across Cultures is one selected bound option, not universal. Africa/Arabic, historical methods, Nomos–Paranomos, PRINS10, Language and Culture in Practice5, area thesis15 and genuine open30 are each counted once.
